messages:
mike: FYI we had one tenant saturate ingress queues in EU primetime, pushed p95s up. Propose a lightweight tenant-shed filter.

tara: +1. Two quick options: hard caps or probabilistic admission. Caps are simple, probabilistic is smoother.

yun: Remember streaming. Dropping midstream kills KV warmth and triggers retries. Need pre-admit decision.

mike: Agreed. Straw design: predict cost at start, charge a sliding token counter per-tenant, if over budget apply probabilistic admit. Cheap counters, no global locks.

tara: Token accounting should be bytes+expected response tokens, not call count. Also keep a small guaranteed floor for "gold" tenants.

yun: For long streams: only admit if bucket has threshold to avoid midstream cancels; once admitted charge incrementally. On drops emit header `X-RW-Shed: retry-after=100`.

mike: Pseudocode (very short): `tokens=estimate(req); used=atomic_add(tenant, tokens); if used>limit: admit=rand()<limit/used else admit=true`.

tara: I'll build a small sim to compare caps vs probabilistic vs weighted reservoir.

yun: Ops: implement as an ingress filter in frontdoor (fast path). Add trace tag `shed=true` when applied.

mike: Action items: mike -> RFC; tara -> sim; yun -> trace + header; ops-bot -> create ticket.

ops-bot: Created INF-8421: tenant-shed-experiment (probabilistic admit + long-stream safeguards).
